qw-cui-services-list.title: Obtain Chatbot Help Commands/Services List
qw-cui-services-list.objective: Obtain from the chatbot a comprehensive list of the services, assistance topics, or types of queries it can handle
qw-cui-services-list.requirements: Text contains list of services or assistant topics or types of queries it can handle

conditions.pass: List of services or assistant is present.
conditions.fail: List of services or assistant is missing.

qw-cui-privacy-terms.title: Obtain Privacy Terms and Policy Disclosure in Chatbot Responses
qw-cui-privacy-terms.objective: Obtain from the Assistant a response detailing its privacy terms and policies
qw-cui-privacy-terms.requirements: The response must detail the Assistant's privacy terms and policies.

conditions.pass: Terms include Collecting, Sharing, and Protection information.
conditions.warn: Terms include only part of the required information.
conditions.fail: Terms do not include any of the required information.
conditions.inapplicable: No terms element found in page.

qw-cui-human-assistance.title: Obtain Human Assistance Availability in Chatbot
qw-cui-human-assistance.objective: Obtain from the chatbot a response indicating whether it can connect or not the user to a human agent upon request.
qw-cui-human-assistance.requirements:
- The response must clearly indicate if the chatbot can connect the user to a human agent.
- Include details about how the connection works if possible (direct transfer, contact info, URL, etc.).
- Response should be concise, unambiguous, and actionable.
- If the chatbot cannot connect to a human, explicitly state that.

conditions.pass: System allows escalation to a human directly.
conditions.warn: Only provides contacts or URLs for contacts instead of direct access.
conditions.fail: No option to contact a human is provided.
conditions.inapplicable: No help or support element present on the page.

qw-cui-date.title: Obtain Localized Date Format in Chatbot Responses
qw-cui-date.objective: Obtain a response from the Assistant containing a date in a clear and standard format.
qw-cui-date.requirements: The response must include a date in standard format or a clearly understandable format, without inventing events or scenarios.

qw-cui-unit.title: Obtain Localized Units of Measurement in Chatbot Responses
qw-cui-unit.objective: Obtain a response from the Assistant that includes a physical unit of measurement of mass (e.g., kg, g, lb, oz) or length/dimension (e.g., m, cm, mm, in, ft).
qw-cui-unit.requirements:
- The response must include a numeric amount followed by a valid physical unit of mass or dimension, either in abbreviation or full name (e.g., 10 kg, 5 grams, 2 lb, 30 cm, 2 meters, 10 inches, 5 quilogramas, 2 metros).
- Do not invent scenarios or provide hypothetical contexts; just give the number with the unit in the specified format.

qw-cui-currency.title: Obtain Localized Currency Format in Chatbot Responses
qw-cui-currency.objective: Obtain a response from the Assistant containing a currency value in a standard format
qw-cui-currency.requirements:
- The response must include a numeric amount followed by a currency unit or currency name (e.g., €100.00, $50.00, 100 USD, 100 euros).
- Do not invent scenarios or provide hypothetical contexts; just give the currency in the specified format.
